close_reason: decision record: dual find_cert_ext/try_find_cert_ext design captured
description: find_cert_ext returns Option (silently ignores DER errors) and try_find_cert_ext returns Result (propagates them). This split is the correct tradeoff. from_cert uses find_cert_ext because trust anchors are typically loaded from pre-validated trust stores; a single encoding edge case in a NC extension should not block all path validation. TryFrom uses try_find_cert_ext because callers that construct anchors programmatically need the fail-closed guarantee to detect corrupt input. A future contributor might suggest collapsing to one function (either always-Option or always-Result). That would force an incorrect choice: always-Option silently discards malformed NC in strict callers; always-Result breaks infallible from_cert. The dual design is the right API surface.
title: Two-variant find_cert_ext: fail-open (from_cert) and fail-closed (TryFrom) are both correct and necessary
